title: Add benchmark-lab profiling baselines and reporting pipeline v93
author: Maya Kapoor
release_notes: Adds profiling baselines and a reporting pipeline to collect profiling metrics for adaptive batching experiments; no user-facing changes.
description: Motivation: produce stable profiling baselines and an automated reporting pipeline for the benchmark-lab to accelerate adaptive-batching and KV-cache workstreams. This PR adds representative workload runners, baseline profiles for common model families, and a scheduled reporting pipeline that aggregates runtime metrics (latency p50/p95, memory usage, kv-cache hit rates, batch sizes) into the performance dashboard. Summary of changes: 1) benchmark-lab/runners: new mixed_workload_runner and conv_example_runner to cover chat-style and instruction-style traffic; 2) benchmark-lab/profiling: baseline JSONs for llama-family and redwood-*-ft models and a small runner to generate baselines; 3) ci/pipelines/benchmark_reporting.yaml: scheduled Airflow pipeline that collects profiling artifacts and uploads to S3 and the reporting API; 4) infra/metrics: new metric exporters for per-model kv-cache hit rate and effective batch occupancy; 5) docs: updated benchmark-lab README with instructions for running baselines and verifying reports. Testing & validation: local unit tests for runners, end-to-end infra smoke test in a staging cluster, and a dry-run of the reporting pipeline against synthetic data. Performance impact: no runtime changes to production serving; only observability and offline runners. Rollout: feature gated behind benchmark-lab feature flag; pipeline scheduled to run nightly in staging for two weeks before enabling for prod. Checklist: [x] implementation compiles and unit tests pass, [x] CI pipeline added and green, [x] staging smoke tests, [x] docs updated, [x] owners added for pipeline alerts. Related work: ENG-3189 (adaptive batching experiment), ENG-3190 (kv-cache telemetry).
